meta.title: OctopusOn SEO account
meta.description: OctopusOn SEO credits, devices and usage.

auth.signInLead: Your credits and connected programs in one account.
auth.signUpLead: The programs are free with your own keys. The account is for using paid sources with OctopusOn SEO credits.
auth.name: Full name
auth.resetLead: Enter your account's e-mail and we will send a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If the address has an account, the link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Your password changed; sign in with the new one.
auth.resetInvalid: The link is invalid or expired; ask for a new one.
auth.verifyLead: We sent you a verification link. Your account is ready once you open it.
auth.notVerified: Your e-mail is not verified; we sent you a new link.
auth.twoFactorLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.terms: By creating an account you accept the terms of use and the privacy notice.
auth.failed: Could not sign in; check the e-mail and password.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Your balance, recent usage and connected programs.
dashboard.noCredits: You have no credits yet. Buy some so the programs can use paid sources through your OctopusOn SEO account.
dashboard.lowBalance: Your balance is low. When credits run out, the programs switch to your own key or the next source.
dashboard.empty: No credit requests yet. In a program, open Sources → OctopusOn SEO account → Connect account.
dashboard.howTitle: How to use it in the programs
dashboard.how: In OctopusOn SERP Checker or OctopusOn SEO Keyword Research, open Sources → OctopusOn SEO account → Connect account and approve the code on the page that opens. Then choose "Credits" for a paid source. Using your own keys stays free.

buy.title: Buy credits
buy.lead: Credits let you use paid sources (SERPs, volumes, backlinks) through OctopusOn SEO. Credits work only in OctopusOn SEO programs; they cannot be transferred or cashed out.
buy.rateNote: Credits are priced at the Central Bank of Turkey's USD rate at payment time plus a {buffer}% exchange margin.
buy.soon: Payments are being set up; buying credits opens soon.
buy.profileRequired: Enter your invoice details and phone number before paying.
buy.consent: I have read and accept the pre-information form and the distance sales contract. I want the credits added to my account at once and know there is no right of withdrawal for this immediately performed service.
buy.overFirst: Your first purchase can be at most {max}.
buy.rateUnavailable: No exchange rate could be fetched; try again shortly.
buy.paid: Payment received; {credits} credits were added to your account.
buy.pending: Your payment is being processed; this page refreshes every few seconds.
buy.transferNote: For now you pay by bank transfer: choose an amount, then you get the bank details and the order's reference. Your credits are added when the transfer arrives, usually within one business day.
buy.transferLead: Pay the amount in one of the ways below and add the order's reference. The {credits} credits are added to your account when the money arrives.
buy.transferSteps: Write the reference exactly in the description so we can match your transfer. Credits are usually added within one business day; the order then shows as paid under Invoices.
buy.payoneerSteps: Open the Payoneer page, enter exactly this amount in US dollars and paste the reference into the description. You can pay by card, bank transfer or PayPal without a Payoneer account; card payments usually arrive within an hour.
buy.payoneerNote: For now you pay through Payoneer (card, bank transfer or PayPal): choose an amount, then you get the payment link and the order's reference. Your credits are added when the payment arrives.
buy.transferPayoneerNote: For now you pay by bank transfer or through Payoneer (card, bank transfer or PayPal): choose an amount, then you get the payment details and the order's reference. Your credits are added when the payment arrives.

billing.title: Invoices
billing.lead: Your invoice details, orders and e-Archive / e-Invoice documents.
billing.phoneHint: Required by the payment provider; with +90.
billing.companyRequired: A company invoice needs the company name, tax number and tax office.

usage.title: Usage
usage.lead: A summary of your credit requests. Request contents (keywords, results) are not stored; only the source, endpoint, status and amount are recorded.

tokens.title: Devices
tokens.lead: Programs connected to your account. Every device has its own token; switch off a lost device here.
tokens.revokeConfirm: This device will no longer be able to use credits. Continue?
tokens.createLead: Create a token by hand for octopuson-keywords or octopuson-serp. It is shown only once.
tokens.created: Copy this token now; it will not be shown again:

device.title: Connect a device
device.lead: Enter the code the program shows.
device.wants: {client} wants to connect to your account.
device.check: Make sure the letters match what you see in the program. Never approve a code someone else sent you.
device.approved: The device is connected. You can return to the program.
device.invalid: This code is invalid or expired. Press "Connect" in the program again.

profile.title: Account settings
profile.twoFactorOn: On. Signing in asks for the code from your authenticator app.
profile.twoFactorRequired: Turn on two-step sign-in before using the admin panel.
profile.scan: Scan this code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or a similar app, then enter the app's code.
profile.backupCodes: Backup codes (if you lose your phone). Keep them somewhere safe:

admin.overviewLead: Last 30 days. Amounts come from the micro-dollar ledger.
admin.connectorsLead: Providers the gateway forwards to with our accounts. A new service is added as a new connector, without code.
admin.configurationHint: Every save is a new version. Active requires terms.confirmed to be true.
admin.termsConfirmed: The provider's written permission to resell is on file
admin.secretsLead: Our provider keys. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.testLead: Sends the configuration's test request with our key. The provider charges us; no user is charged.
admin.balanceLow: Below the threshold: top up the provider account.
admin.settingsLead: Default markup, credit unit, packages and limits.
admin.reportsLead: Revenue, provider cost and margin per connector and day (last 30 days).
admin.ordersLead: Credit sales, payment provider records and invoices.
admin.refundConfirm: Did you refund the payment at the provider? The credits will be taken back.
admin.chargebackConfirm: The credits will be taken back and the account suspended. Continue?
admin.noPayments: No payment provider is configured (PAYMENT_PROVIDER). Credit sales are closed.
admin.noInvoicing: Paraşüt is not configured; invoices go to the accountant as CSV.
admin.transferReceivedConfirm: Did this order's transfer arrive in full? Its credits are added to the account now.
admin.cancelOrderConfirm: Close this waiting order without adding credits?
admin.transferDone: Marked paid; the credits were added.

legal.draft: Draft: these terms take effect after a lawyer's review.
legal.binding: This translation is for information; the Turkish text is binding.
